My research interests span statistical methodology and causal
inference, with applications in infectious disease and immunology, pulmonary and critical care, and substance use research.

For a complete list of publications, please see my
[Google Scholar profile](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=73RvTUoAAAAJ&hl=en)
or [CV](../static/hoffman_cv_nov26.pdf).

\* Indicates co-first authorship.
